purpose: Define the minimum multi-domain task population and evidence boundaries needed for a credible first PLH/ORCA AX paper.

deferredScenarioClasses.reason: Scientific use requires live executor interruption rather than between-execution simulation.

baselineLadder.name: strong_single_agent
baselineLadder.requirement: same model, tools, grader, and task budget

baselineLadder.name: static_workflow
baselineLadder.requirement: fixed routing/workflow with no state-responsive reassignment

baselineLadder.name: fixed_specialist_team
baselineLadder.requirement: persistent specialist identities with fixed responsibility ownership

baselineLadder.name: dynamic_predefined_roles
baselineLadder.requirement: dynamic assignee changes allowed, but role/function ontology fixed before execution

baselineLadder.name: plh_orca_ax
baselineLadder.requirement: state-derived Need, temporary Responsibility, guarded wake-up, team-aware allocation, situated matching, authoritative evidence

analysisPlan.uncertainty: paired bootstrap interval when sample size supports it; otherwise exact paired outcomes plus descriptive intervals

freezeRules: Do not change matcher weights, trigger thresholds, grader semantics, or baseline definitions after inspecting prospective task outcomes.
Bug fixes that change semantics require a new evaluation-set version and rerun of all affected prospective conditions.
The two prospective TaskPacks may not be reclassified as development tasks after outcomes are seen.
No claim of broad superiority may rely on the basketball mechanism catalog or on post-hoc deployment diagnostics.
